description_en: Uploads text-type phase data to the blockchain and optionally associates it with other phase data
description_zh: 上传文本类型的阶段数据到区块链，并同时可以绑定所关联的其它阶段数据
kebab_example: aliyun ltl upload-mpcos-phase-text-info --biz-api-version 1.0.0 --biz-chain-id 4899730875490000 --phase-group-id 3838607922870000 --phase-id 1964875128110000 --data-key 32bfce96b4e2f9bec0f2ea5cc2f14ace1486cc146d5832d3a84e5332fe890000 --data-seq be350cd52b0f47846f93df7d0d4febd86025ee6c028a6b22a6ff1ac6d3a20000 --phase-data 9878230743340000 --related-data-list '[{relatedDataKey=be350cd52b0f47846f93df7d0d4febd86025ee6c028a6b22a6ff1ac6d3a20000, relatedPhaseData=某公司某业务数据。, relatedDataSeq =b71cca5502d8d7d0057a5ebf44d78ae75280436b86dcbda643c4d264ff2a0000, relatedPhaseId=9878230743340000}]' --region cn-hangzhou
name: UploadMPCoSPhaseTextInfo

parameters.help_en: The API version number. Set the value to "1.0.0"
parameters.name: api_version

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the data
parameters.name: data_key

parameters.help_en: The phase data. The value must be 1 to 4,096 bytes in length. Each Chinese character occupies two bytes
parameters.help_zh: 阶段数据。长度要求1~4096字节，一个中文字符占两位字符
parameters.name: phase_data

parameters.help_en: The list of related data. For more information, see the RelatedData table below
parameters.help_zh: 关联数据列表。详情请参见下表RelatedData
parameters.name: related_data_list
